explicitExclusions.reason: Historical archives and binary media were inventoried, not unpacked or security audited.
Dependency advisory checks were performed separately during remediation; not an exhaustive source audit of dependencies.

openQuestions.question: Whether any historical proxy is publicly deployed with a real key or additional ingress limits.
Whether any distributed build replaces the placeholder OAuth client ID; token disclosure requires a stored account token.

surfaces.label: Extension credentials and messaging boundaries
surfaces.notes: Traced options OAuth storage to five external background handlers and their manifest allowlists; evaluated content-script storage, extension-page rendering and sender boundaries.

surfaces.label: Proxy route authentication, availability and error handling
surfaces.notes: Reviewed both unique server variants, six equivalent health routes, rate limiter placement, URL construction and error serialization. Deployment and reverse-proxy behavior remain unknown.

surfaces.label: Untrusted metadata, page DOM and backup imports
surfaces.notes: Reviewed original title rendering and all active import-handler variants. Confirmed watched metadata HTML injection, three page-readable sessionStorage watchlists and v1.1 import-to-CSS path. CSP and broken later event binding limit impact/reachability.

surfaces.label: Detection lifecycle and all remaining content variants
surfaces.notes: Full source or complete differing hunks reviewed for v1, Copy, v1.1/v1.2 and v1.4/v1.5 detector, knowledge, integration, content and popup variants. Additional functional gaps include dropped mutations, stale attributes, disabled-mode observers and keyword settings ignored by active V4 logic; not classified as attacker-driven security findings.

surfaces.label: Metadata builders and legacy auxiliary modules
surfaces.notes: Reviewed unique TMDB builders, Wikipedia enrichment, compression, V3 enhancement/integration/options, V4 bridge and asset conversion scripts. No additional validated remote-code execution or arbitrary-host credential disclosure. Some modules are not loaded by the manifest.

surfaces.label: Persistence, onboarding and developer benchmarks
surfaces.notes: Reviewed real/stub IndexedDB implementations, both onboarding variants, i18n and complete benchmark/test scripts; hash-identical copies inherit review. Destructive historical phrase migration and benchmark exit-status/fixture-count defects are functional issues. No externally reachable database writer or attacker-controlled eval source was established.

surfaces.label: Extension external messaging, metadata rendering and legacy backup boundaries
surfaces.notes: Validated by independent baseline and parent source review. Chrome external admission/CSP limit exploit reachability; OAuth needs working configuration.

surfaces.label: Proxy health request budget and raw-error disclosure
surfaces.notes: Fixed upstream host/path allowlist rejects SSRF. Parent verified node-fetch 2.7.0 URL-bearing network error formatting from official source; no deployment probed.

surfaces.label: Legacy content-script page storage
surfaces.notes: Full selectedMedia list crosses into page-origin sessionStorage in v1.1-v1.3.
